Mei: Heads-up: we need a concise launch gate for the Optimize Toolkit pilot with customer Horizon. They want batching/caching/quant recs + alerting. Can we agree on pass/fail and experiment design today?
Carlos: Propose a simple risk matrix for the pilot (Low / Medium / High) mapped to config aggressiveness.
- Low risk: batch-safe + q8 (target cache only on idempotent routes)
- Medium risk: batch-hybrid + q8 (wider cache where privacy-ok)
- High risk: batch-max + q4 (only after golden-set pass)
Jenna: Acceptance criteria suggestion (measurable):
- Econ: projected cost reduction >= 12% (pilot threshold) and >= 20% for bold win
- Quality: core task accuracy drop <= 1.0% absolute on seeded set
- Latency: p50 <= 125ms for all routes; p95 <= 360ms for low/medium risk routes
Omar: For rollout gating, add: no primary eval alerts for 48h AND golden-set failure rate <= 1.5% over same window. If primary alert fires once, we pause and investigate; twice -> auto-rollback.
cs-bot: CS note: Horizon must sign off on which endpoints are cacheable and provide 200 golden prompts within 48h.
Mei: Experiment plan: run three parallel cohorts (safe, hybrid, aggressive) with traffic-split 40/40/20. Collect econ, latency, quality, cache hit per cohort. Use experiment_id tag.
Carlos: Telemetry to capture: per-cohort token cost, cache_hit_ratio (by prefix), batch_delay_ms histogram, latency buckets, primary metric, human-review samples. Also capture quant perplexity delta.
Jenna: Eval-alerts specifics:
- primary_metric = "business_accuracy"
- baseline = measured on previous 14 days
- alert_if_drop_abs = 0.01 (1%) over 60m with min_samples=80
- embedding_warning: mean_cosine_shift > 0.02 over 2h
Mei: Rollback strategy: switch traffic to baseline variant + disable batching for affected route; ops to run a quick warm restart if memory/kv issues observed. Omar to own rollback playbook.
Omar: I'll add concrete runbook steps (toggle flags, rollback script, page oncall). Also recommend a manual hold point after 12h to review human-annotated samples.
Carlos: On caching policy: default off, enable only after CS whitelist. For enabled routes, require TTLs <= 1h for Horizon due to freshness concerns.
Jenna: Quality guard: golden-set (200 prompts) must be re-run after any quant change. Fail if >1.5% regression. Also require at least one human spot-check per day during pilot.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled -> optimize/horizon/pilot/1765557777 (status: scheduled) :calendar:
Mei: Decisions summarized:
- Three cohorts (safe/hybrid/aggressive) with 40/40/20 split
- Acceptance gates: econ >=12% pilot pass, quality_drop <=1.0% on seeded set, no primary alerts (48h)
- Auto-rollback after two primary alerts in 48h; manual hold after first alert
- Cache only on CS-approved endpoints; TTL <=1h where enabled
- Telemetry + tagged experiment_id for comparisons
Action items: @Omar (rollback runbook + hold checklist), @Jenna (golden-set + eval-alert config PR), @Carlos (telemetry dashboard + cost projection), @CS (Horizon cache whitelist + golden prompts).
Mei: I'll write this into the pilot kickoff doc and ping Horizon once CS confirms whitelist. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
